# Tribelt – your partner in metal conveyor belts

> Tribelt is a manufacturer and specialist in metal conveyor belt systems for industrial applications. We design, produce, and supply conveyor belts used in thermal processing, food production, industrial automation, and heavy-duty material handling. Metal conveyor belts are engineered systems used for transporting products under demanding conditions such as high temperatures, continuous operation, hygiene requirements, or mechanical stress.
Tribelt supports engineers, system integrators, and technical procurement teams in selecting and optimising belt solutions based on performance, durability, and application requirements.

---
## Core expertise

- Design and production of metal conveyor belt systems
- Engineering of customised belt solutions for specific industrial processes
- Technical support for belt selection, integration, and optimisation
- In-house production ensuring control over quality and lead times
- Support for maintenance, replacement, and system upgrades

## Frequently asked questions

- [What is a metal conveyor belt?]: A metal conveyor belt is a steel-based transport system used for moving products under high temperature, heavy load, or hygienic conditions.
- [What is an Eye Link belt used for?]: An Eye Link belt is used in thermal and industrial processes such as baking, drying, cooling, and cleaning due to its open structure and heat resistance.
- [When is a Balanced Weave belt used?]: Balanced Weave belts are used in applications requiring stable tracking, high temperature resistance, and continuous transport.
- [What are the advantages of a Tri-Flex belt?]: Tri-Flex belts allow both straight and curved transport paths, have high load capacity, and are suitable for hygienic and industrial applications.
- [Which industries use Tribelt conveyor belts?]: Tribelt belts are used in food processing, pharmaceuticals, automotive manufacturing, recycling, electronics, and industrial production systems.

## Practical applications

Tribelt conveyor belts are applied in:

- Continuous industrial production processes
